name: Mental Surgery
description: Future Crew's demo of 1991, their last to run on a 286
author: Future Crew

start.note: DosKit answers its five setup questions: a machine of 12 MHz or faster, no trouble with smooth scrolling, and a Sound Blaster at 220h, IRQ 7.

hint: Mental Surgery asks five questions before it starts: press Y, N and Y, then Enter twice, for a Sound Blaster at 220h, IRQ 7.
